sonnet.problem: This story card only adds a joke about Abram and the junk drawer. It tells nothing new from the passage and repeats Genesis 16:5, which card 7 already told. It is a reaction card with no forward movement.
sonnet.rule: Every story card moves the baker forward through the passage. ... No recap cards. ... Every story card tells part of the passage. Jokes ride along on those cards.

sonnet.problem: The statement bundles two claims. 'Sarai treats Hagar harshly' is true and 'Hagar stays with her' is false, so the card tests more than one claim and a baker can't tell which part is being marked.
sonnet.rule: A true or false statement tests one claim.
